qianxiang.guide.first_join: A wandering sage roams the land — find him and sneak+right-click to begin cultivation (press O for the skill tree). Press B for the spell wheel, J for active skills.
item.qianxiang.ember_crystal.lore: A remnant of fire; used to ignite weapons or spells.
item.qianxiang.beast_fang.lore: A beast's broken tooth, sharp enough to tear flesh.
item.qianxiang.glimmer_wood_sap.lore: Living sap from the Myriad Tree; soothes wounds.
item.qianxiang.shadowhide_patch.lore: Chilled hide from abyssal spiders; slows and protects.
item.qianxiang.ember_iron.lore: Iron steeped in salamander blood; warm and searing.
item.qianxiang.bloodroot.lore: A blood-drinking vine; the core of life-stealing tools.
item.qianxiang.abyss_iron.lore: Cold iron from the abyssal floor; heavy and enduring.
item.qianxiang.salamander_gland.lore: The fire sac of a salamander; offense and defense as one.
item.qianxiang.dragon_bone.lore: Black-jade dragon bone from the Sand Sea; sharp as starlight.
item.qianxiang.rift_essence.lore: A shard of primal chaos from the rift; root of all magic.
item.qianxiang.frost_crystal.lore: A frozen core condensed in the aurora's depths; frost follows its touch.
item.qianxiang.thunder_stone.lore: Stone fallen on the Dragonspine on a stormy night; lightning still runs within.
item.qianxiang.venom_gland.lore: A gland cut from a venomous beast; one drop corrodes bone.
item.qianxiang.shadow_dust.lore: Dust of coagulated shadow; slows the world and sees through night.
item.qianxiang.holy_shard.lore: A last fragment of dying holy light; it whispers of mending and renewal.
item.qianxiang.nature_breath.lore: A breath of the Myriad Wilds; where it lands, life takes root.
item.qianxiang.void_shard.lore: A shard of echoing void; hold it, and gravity seems to forget you.
item.qianxiang.myriad_fragment.lore: A fractured echo of the Myriad Wilds; hums with unrealized possibility.
item.qianxiang.reverse_core.lore: A core of inverted duality. While present, every concept turns to its opposite: venom to remedy, fire to frost, harm to ward.

qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.dialog.neut: Wandering Sage: The phases flow without form. May you find your own path among the fragments.
qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.dialog.dipl: Wandering Sage: Your diplomatic brand burns bright... Qianxiang listens to those who speak.
qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.dialog.slau: Wandering Sage: The stench of blood is heavy on you. The phases remember every kill.
qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.price.norma: [Sage] A fair price; the phases do not deceive.
qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.price.disco: [Sage] Your reputation is favorable, so I offer a discount.
qianxiang.npc.wandering_sage.price.premi: [Sage] Your brand unsettles me. The price must rise.
qianxiang.npc.abyss_merchant.dialog.neut: Abyss Merchant: In the rift, anything can be traded... if you have the chips.
qianxiang.npc.abyss_merchant.dialog.dipl: Abyss Merchant: I like doing business with civilized travelers. Profit and trust, together.
qianxiang.npc.abyss_merchant.dialog.slau: Abyss Merchant: A guest reeking of slaughter... The abyss has no shortage of blood, but it lacks manners.
qianxiang.npc.abyss_merchant.price.disco: [Abyss Merchant] For a regular, a rift-price.
qianxiang.npc.abyss_merchant.price.premi: [Abyss Merchant] Your brand makes the goods risky. Thirty percent more.

qianxiang.guide.title: Qianxiang Forge Guide
qianxiang.guide.tpl.hint: (Click a cyan example to fill the input box)
qianxiang.guide.p1.title: What is this?
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.1: The forge table is FREE forging: no fixed recipes.
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.2: ◆ Materials are parts, each with operators:
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.4: Parts in, effects out. Materials decide all.
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.5: ◆ AI is the recipe brain: say what you want,
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.6: it picks parts and proposes recipe cards.
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.10: ◆ Power has a price: strong weapons carry drawbacks
qianxiang.guide.p1.line.11: (e.g. attacks drain hunger). Red tooltip lines = feature.
qianxiang.guide.p2.title: How to use?
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.1: 1. Below the input box: choose type and power tier
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.3: 2. Describe what you want in one sentence.
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.4: 3. Press "Ask AI"; recipe cards appear below.
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.5: 4. Click a card to auto-place materials
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.7: 5. Take the product from the result slot!
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.8: "AI Confirm" checks your placed material combo.
qianxiang.guide.p2.line.9: Like a combo? "Save Blueprint" inscribes it;
qianxiang.guide.p3.title: Reference 1: Custom Materials
qianxiang.guide.p3.line.4: Glimmer Wood Sap [Common] Wood frame + Heal
qianxiang.guide.p3.line.12: Tip: found in the Myriad Wilds and from NPCs.
qianxiang.guide.p4.title: Reference 2: Vanilla Materials
qianxiang.guide.p4.line.4: Bone -> Bone frame; Leather -> Hide frame
qianxiang.guide.p5.title: Reference 3: Operators (Base & Offense)
qianxiang.guide.p5.line.2: Metal Base | weapon/tool <- iron, ember iron
qianxiang.guide.p5.line.4: Bone Base | weapon <- bone, dragon bone
qianxiang.guide.p6.title: Reference 4: Operators (Defense & Utility)
qianxiang.guide.p6.line.6: Night Vision | see in dark <- golden carrot
qianxiang.guide.p6.line.10: Fire Resist | no fire (armor) <- magma cream
qianxiang.guide.p6.line.12: Regeneration | heal over time <- ghast tear
qianxiang.guide.p6.line.14: Area Harvest | wide till (tool) <- echo shard
qianxiang.guide.p7.title: Reference 5: Status Effects (Combat)
qianxiang.guide.p8.title: Reference 6: Status Effects (Rare)
qianxiang.guide.p8.line.6: Heart of the sea -> Dolphin's grace
qianxiang.guide.p8.line.10: datapacks can attach any effect to any item.

qianxiang.guide.glossary.debuff.note: Ask the AI for "all debuffs / curse" to get them all.
